text: After numerous failed attempts to rectify my issues with Mohela, I am completely frustrated.I have submitted information and documentation in regards to my loans. Yet I was informed that a forbearnace would be needed due to back log. That request has not been completed and I keep recieving bills despite I should not. No updates have been given after calls by myself to check status but the same rhetorical statements. This has placed me in a horrible situation ( credit reporting which is unfair ) that I would like to be rectified. Mohela calls range from ( 2-3 hr hold times ) with no resolution.
